resilience.note: Armoured Carapace: AR 3, Timesplinter Mantle: AR 2*

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of each of this Threat’s turns.

bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Chronometron
bonuses.text: Once per turn, this Threat can select a target within 10m that shares the same [DYNASTY] Keyword. The target triples its movement when it chooses to Charge and gains +2 AR* until the end of its next turn.

abilities.name: Chronotendrils
abilities.text: Whenever the Technomancer is attacked in melee, it may make a counter attack using its Chronotendrils with the following profile: 7 +2 ED / Rending 4. The Chronomancer can use its Chronotendrils 3 times per Round.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.
